reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is transforming modern education by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly, helping students progress at their own pace. Teachers benefit from automated grading and data analytics, allowing them to focus more on mentoring and classroom instruction. However, concerns about privacy and the digital divide remain significant challenges. Educational institutions must balance technological innovation with equitable access to ensure all students benefit from these advances.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of AI in education?
options: A) It eliminates the need for teachers
B) It personalizes learning experiences for students
C) It reduces the cost of textbooks
D) It prevents students from making mistakes
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'AI-powered systems can analyze individual learning patterns and adapt content accordingly'라고 명시되어 있어 개인화된 학습 경험이 AI의 이점임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned about AI implementation in education?
options: A) Teachers will refuse to use technology
B) Students will become too dependent on AI
C) Privacy and digital divide are significant challenges
D) AI is too expensive for schools
questions.explanation: 'Educational institutions must balance technological innovation with equitable access'라는 문장에서 개인정보 보호와 디지털 격차가 주요 과제임을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: How does AI help teachers according to the passage?
options: A) It replaces the need for teacher training
B) It provides automated grading and data analytics
C) It eliminates classroom instruction entirely
D) It reduces student enrollment
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Teachers benefit from automated grading and data analytics, allowing them to focus more on mentoring'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that artificial intelligence will eventually replace most human jobs? Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 자신의 입장을 명확히 하는 thesis statement로 시작하세요. 예: 'I partly agree that AI will replace some jobs, but new opportunities will emerge' 또는 'I disagree because humans will always be needed for creative and emotional work.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유를 제시하고 구체적인 예시를 포함하세요. 예를 들어, 제조업, 데이터 분석 등의 반복적인 일자리는 자동화될 가능성이 높다는 점을 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유로 인간만이 수행할 수 있는 역할을 강조하세요. 창의성, 감정 지능, 윤리적 판단 등의 분야에서 인간의 가치를 설명하세요.
structure.conclusion: 자신의 주장을 재정리하고 AI와 인간이 함께 일하는 미래에 대한 희망적인 메시지로 마무리하세요.

useful_phrases: Furthermore, it is important to consider...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer learning through technology and online courses. Others prefer traditional classroom learning. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and examples in your response.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
sample_points: 온라인 학습은 유연성과 자유로운 시간 관리가 가능하며, 자신의 속도에 맞춰 학습할 수 있다는 장점이 있습니다.
전통적인 교실 학습은 대면 상호작용, 즉각적인 피드백, 그리고 강사와의 직접적인 관계 형성이 가능하다는 이점이 있습니다.

listening.title: Career Counseling Office Discussion
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm looking for advice on which major to choose. I'm interested in both engineering and business. Counselor: That's great that you're considering your options carefully. Tell me, what aspects of engineering appeal to you? Student: Well, I enjoy solving complex problems and working with technology. Counselor: And what about business interests you? Student: I like the idea of starting my own company someday. I think understanding business operations and management would help me achieve that goal. Counselor: Those are two different paths. Have you considered engineering management? It combines technical expertise with business knowledge. Many engineers move into management positions. Student: That sounds interesting! Could you tell me more about that path? Counselor: Of course. Many companies need leaders who understand both technology and business. It's an excellent career option with strong job prospects and good earning potential.

questions.q: What is the student's main concern in this conversation?
options: A) Finding a part-time job
B) Choosing between engineering and business majors
C) Learning about technology companies
D) Understanding business operations
questions.explanation: 학생은 상담자에게 '어떤 전공을 선택할지 조언을 구하고 싶다'고 말합니다. 학생이 공학과 경영 사이에서 고민하고 있으며 이것이 대화의 주제입니다.

questions.q: What does the counselor suggest as an alternative path?
options: A) Business management only
B) Technology entrepreneurship
C) Engineering management
D) Starting a tech company immediately
questions.explanation: 상담자는 학생에게 '공학 관리(engineering management)'를 고려해볼 것을 제안합니다. 이것은 기술 전문성과 경영 지식을 결합한 경로입니다.

questions.q: According to the counselor, why is engineering management a good career choice?
options: A) It's easier than traditional engineering
B) Companies need leaders with both technical and business knowledge
C) It guarantees a job in any company
D) It requires less education
questions.explanation: 상담자는 '많은 회사들은 기술과 경영을 모두 이해하는 리더가 필요하다'고 설명하며, 이것이 강력한 구직 전망과 좋은 수입 가능성을 가진 우수한 커리어 선택지라고 말합니다.
